notes.title: Stars, more stars
notes.notes: Purpose in each level is now try to collect all stars, or at least as many stars as possible. The number of stars is shown. Stars that are collected do not appear again when repeating the level. Due limited number of stars, star prices of upgrades were reduced.

notes.title: Steam deck test fine-tuning
notes.notes:
Steam deck gameplay has been tested again and some fine-tunings were done:
-A button jumps
-Videos works

notes.title: Snow effect under sleigh
notes.notes: There is also a snow effect when collisioned with ground.

notes.title: Small animations for Santa and Deck usability improvements
notes.notes:
-Santa has some animations now. 
-Steam Deck RB/LB can be used to select chapter

notes.title: Deck usability improved
notes.notes:
-Returning from the actual game to main menu easy with single button
-Shows glyph for jumping if Deck used

notes.title: Hotfix for language support
notes.notes: Some texts in some languages with longer texts were not fully visible. Fixed them. Now several languages are live.

notes.title: Language support
notes.notes:
Added language support for game. Now this festival game can be played using languages of 
arabic, chinese (simple), finnish, german, portuguese, brazilian, french, spanish, swedish and japanese. Translations are not perfect, but the game is good. If you want, you can come to our discord channel to make translations better for future versions.
